title: Special Topics in Latin American and Caribbean Studies; Creative Writing and Technology in Spanish Social Media
description:
Cross-listed with SPAN359T and USLT398C. Credit only granted for LACS348K, SPAN359T, or USLT398C.

Designed for students from all majors and career paths, whether you're an artist, business professional, marketer, or future lawyer, this innovative course invites students to explore the intersection of creative writing and visual storytelling. By integrating technology and platforms like Canva, students will learn to craft compelling narratives that blend words and images, essential skills for any field where storytelling is key. Whether presenting a personal story, promoting a product, or conveying an idea, the ability to tell a story effectively is invaluable. Taught in English, but Spanish majors/minors will be required to submit assignments in Spanish.
